summary.en: An element's oxide is basic if the element is strongly metallic, acidic if the element is strongly nonmetallic, and amphoteric for elements near the metal-nonmetal boundary, and the same trend continues into oxoacids — acids containing a central atom bonded to oxygen — whose acid strength increases with the electronegativity and oxidation state of that central atom.
summary.et: Elemendi oksiid on aluseline, kui element on tugevalt metalliline, happeline, kui element on tugevalt mittemetalliline, ja amfoteerne elementide jaoks, mis asuvad metalli-mittemetalli piiri lähedal, ning sama trend jätkub hapnikhapetes — hapetes, mis sisaldavad hapnikuga seotud tsentraalset aatomit —, mille happe tugevus kasvab selle tsentraalse aatomi elektronegatiivsuse ja oksüdatsiooniastmega.
